home.backup-desc: Copy personal folders, projects, saved games and supported settings to ZIP, 7z or a folder, verified with SHA-256.
home.first-run-detail: Open your backup or import your configuration to recover your profiles, program library and preferences without setting anything up by hand.
home.personalization-desc: File Explorer, taskbar, Start, appearance, startup and preinstalled apps.
home.prepare-desc: Check that your backup is complete and verified, and create the install USB.
home.principles-text: Everything runs locally: no telemetry, no accounts and no ads. Nothing changes without your confirmation, Windows protections are never disabled and a backup is only marked as successful after it passes verification.
home.privacy-desc: Ads, diagnostics, recommendations, app permissions and search, with their real state.
home.programs-desc: Your program list with official sources: download the latest verified versions and install when you approve.
home.restore-desc: Restore selectively on this PC, even with a different user name, drive or Windows version.
home.subtitle: Back up your files and settings, get your PC ready before reinstalling, recover your setup afterwards and tune Windows with reversible changes.
home.title: Welcome to Windows Reborn
